steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS; the prepared state is the required starting point.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before interacting with the prepared event.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate the available line 1 quantity to Vendor B, matching the lower 90-per-unit bid.
Verify the available one-line allocation and its calculated proposal value of 10 × 90 = 900.
Create the award proposal from the allocation screen.
Assert that the proposal page opened.
Fill any mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Verify that the submitted proposal is awaiting approval.

args.need: sign in as the assigned approver and approve the submitted proposal with the remark "OK — QA"

steps.note: The separate approver session and approval action require tester-provided access.
Verify that the proposal shows the approved state after the approver completes the action.
Create the purchase order from the approved award for the available awarded line.
Verify that the resulting PO contains the one available awarded line with quantity 10.
